#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

class FastReader {
    ifstream fin;
    stringstream ss;
public:
    FastReader() {
        fin.open("input.txt");
        if (!fin.is_open()) {
            fin = cin;
        }
    }

    string next() {
        if (ss.empty()) {
            ss.str("");
            ss << fin.rdbuf();
        }
        string str;
        while (ss >> str) {
            return str;
        }
        return "";
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long nextLong() {
        return stol(next());
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }

    string nextLine() {
        string str;
        getline(fin, str);
        return str;
    }
};

bool solve(long w, long m) {
    return w <= 3 || m == 1 || trySolve(w, m-1) || trySolve(w, m) || trySolve(w, m+1);
}

bool trySolve(long w, long m) {
    return m%w == 0 && solve(w, m/w);
}

int main() {
    FastReader sc;
    long w = sc.nextLong();
    long m = sc.nextLong();
    if(solve(w,m))
        cout << "YES" << endl;
    else
        cout << "NO" << endl;
    return 0;
}
